description: Free. Explain why an email passed or failed authentication or went to spam. Pass the raw message, or just its headers: checks DKIM signatures (verified when the body is included), whether the sending IP is authorized by SPF, DMARC alignment and policy, what the receiving server recorded, and delays at each relay hop. Returns the reasons in plain words.

raw.description: The full message source, or its headers

name: analyze_email_authentication
